record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of fuzzy metric spaces
record.context_brief: Separability of the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff space of compact fuzzy metric spaces.
record.original_question: Let CFM be the set of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces, where a fuzzy metric space is a triple (X, M, *) consisting of a set X, a continuous t-norm * on [0,1], and a function M on X^2 × (0,∞) satisfying positivity, identity of indiscernibles, symmetry, a triangle-type inequality M(x,y,t) * M(y,z,s) ≤ M(x,z,t+s), and continuity in the time variable. When CFM is endowed with the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric, is CFM a separable fuzzy metric space?

evidence.quote: 2. Questions. Denote by CFM the set of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces endowed with the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric. Question 1. Is the space CFM separable?

artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has developed the fuzzy Gromov–Hausdorff metric and established completeness and Gromov-type precompactness theorems in the non-Archimedean setting, but no source located resolves the separability question for the full space of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces. The status appears to remain unresolved in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Gromov-Hausdorff compactness theorem for non-Archimedean Fuzzy Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Every Cauchy sequence of compact non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces is convergent in the non-Archimedean Gromov-Hausdorff fuzzy metric.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work establishes completeness of the non-Archimedean fuzzy Gromov–Hausdorff space but does not establish separability of CFM in general.
